name: scanforge
description: Scan real-world objects into textured 3D models from a phone or laptop camera

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @scanforge/shared && npm run build --workspace @scanforge/server && npm run build --workspace @scanforge/web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build --workspace @scanforge/shared && SCANFORGE_BASE=/SCANFORGE/ VITE_STATIC_BUILD=1 VITE_DEMO_MODEL=/SCANFORGE/example/ npm run build --workspace @scanforge/web
